title: Waxpol Backhoe EP Grease NLGI-3 Multi Purpose 5 Kg – Heavy Duty Extreme Pressure Lubricant for JCB, Excavators, Bearings & Industrial Machinery
description: Waxpol Backhoe EP Grease NLGI-3 is a premium-quality, heavy-duty lubricant specially designed for high-load and extreme working conditions. Manufactured using advanced gel technology and fortified with extreme pressure additives, it delivers excellent lubrication, reduces friction, and ensures smooth operation of machinery components. This multi-purpose grease provides superior protection against wear, rust, and oxidation, significantly enhancing the life of bearings, joints, and moving parts. Its high dropping point ensures consistent performance even at elevated temperatures, while excellent water resistance makes it ideal for outdoor and off-road equipment. Perfect for backhoe loaders, excavators, JCBs, and other heavy machinery, Waxpol EP Grease is engineered to withstand shock loads and harsh environments, reducing maintenance frequency and improving equipment efficiency.
Name: Waxpol Backhoe EP Grease NLGI-3 Multi Purpose 5 Kg – Heavy Duty Extreme Pressure Lubricant for JCB, Excavators, Bearings & Industrial Machinery
